resources.string: Uniform film thickness = fluid volume ÷ coated area. At fixed volume, doubling the area halves the thickness. At fixed area, doubling the volume doubles the thickness.

Goblet cells secrete mucins that help form surface mucus. Airway mucus helps trap inhaled particles; intestinal mucus helps lubricate and protect the lining. For the pharynx, this example refers only to the ciliated respiratory lining in parts of the nasopharynx. The calculation spreads a fictional fluid evenly over a flat patch. All units are arbitrary. It does not represent real mucus thickness or model secretion or clearance over time, assay results, or pathogen spread.
